newsitem.title: LEBANON: Iraqi businessmen to visit Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Iraqi businessmen to visit Lebanon.

text.p: A delegation of Iraqi businessmen will in August visit Lebanon, which severed diplomatic ties with Iraq in 1994.
Adnan Kassar, head of the Lebanese Chamber of Commerce and Industry, said on Thursday that Iraq's Union of Chambers of Commerce had made the request to visit Lebanon and a date was set for August 19.
Lebanon cut diplomatic relations with Iraq in 1994 after charging Iraqi diplomats with the assassination of an Iraqi opposition figure in Beirut.
A delegation of Lebanese businessmen and industrialists visited Baghdad in May. Lebanese government officials said the visit had no political role.
